closure_claim: Every Form W-2G furnished to the taxpayer (and, on a joint return, the spouse) for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item with its box 1 amount as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form W-2G box 1 only: it says nothing about box 4 withholding, gambling winnings without a Form W-2G, gambling losses, or other Schedule 1 items. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
title: Form W-2G box 1 statement items, tax year 2025
